fullValidationReview.note: Full pass with scripts/bulbapedia/sample-review.mjs m --all (seed 20260301, live TCGdex). One flag was a wrong pairing and is dropped through exclusions.json: Perfect Order 117 Wondrous Patch listed jpcardno 103/080, but TCGdex M3-103 is Poké Pad and Wondrous Patch is M3-104. The remaining flags are the energy naming convention ("Nitro R Energy" vs "Nitro Fire Energy", "Voltaic L Energy" vs "Voltaic Lightning Energy").
